d001.name: Ghutrabun
d001.entry: Smiles like it knows what you ordered. It does.

d002.name: Spectopout
d002.entry: Has been 'about to leave' for forty minutes. Glasses fogged from the effort.

d003.name: Puppydome
d003.entry: Its pleading eyes have secured over 400 bites of other people's food.

d004.name: Zipshock
d004.entry: Zips its jacket all the way up when startled, which is always.

d005.name: Grinlord
d005.entry: Its grin has no off switch. Scientists have tried.

d006.name: Quiffle
d006.entry: Spends twenty minutes on its quiff. Then it rains. Every time.

d007.name: Snoozle
d007.entry: Found asleep on the lounge couch in 9 of 10 sightings. The tenth was a different couch.

d008.name: Hoodini
d008.entry: Can vanish entirely inside a hoodie. Has been reported missing twice while present.

d009.name: Lil Dumpz
d009.entry: Throws up hand signs no one recognizes. Claims they stand for 'the lounge'.

d010.name: Beaniblob
d010.entry: Melts into its hoodie at a rate of two centimetres per hour.

d011.name: Fezzington
d011.entry: Begs politely in a fez. Nobody has ever said no to the fez.

d012.name: Lampface
d012.entry: Wears a headlamp indoors 'just in case'. The case has never come.

d013.name: Dumplord
d013.entry: The first face ever squished into a dumpling. Has not stopped smiling about it.

d014.name: Forecasto
d014.entry: Gazes skyward, checking if it's e-skateboard weather. Forecast: not today.

d015.name: Fedorable
d015.entry: Dressed for a mountain hike. Has walked to the car and back.

d016.name: Showerpout
d016.entry: Sulks in a floral shower cap. Do not mention the shower cap.

d017.name: Bedhedgie
d017.entry: Its hair points north. Its plans for the day point nowhere.

d018.name: Ribsy
d018.entry: Sighs at a plate of ribs the way others sigh at sunsets.

d019.name: Gaspo
d019.entry: Wears a collared shirt so its panic looks professional.

d020.name: Gogglo
d020.entry: Its glasses magnify its alarm to three times actual size.

d021.name: Dumplonaut
d021.entry: Went to space looking for a shisha lounge open past 3 a.m. Search ongoing.

d022.name: Daydreamer
d022.entry: Thinking hard about the ribs place. Still cannot remember its name.

d023.name: Sobwards
d023.entry: Wears its cap backwards so the tears have a clear path.

d024.name: Orange Boy
d024.entry: Made entirely of orange peel. Shouts in all caps. Nobody knows who let it in.

d025.name: Foamando
d025.entry: Poses with its foam blaster for twenty minutes before firing it once.

d026.name: Dartvader
d026.entry: Has you in its sights. The dart will bounce off you. It knows. It fires anyway.

d027.name: Puffington
d027.entry: A rare 3D render. Acts like it has its own animated movie coming out.

d028.name: Funguy
d028.entry: A fun guy. Grows in damp corners of the lounge. Please do not stomp on it.

d029.name: Wobblip
d029.entry: Its lower lip has trembled since 2019. It has not cried yet. It is close.

d030.name: Suhaibabe
d030.entry: Crossed the border in disguise. Customs waved it straight through.

d031.name: Panicam
d031.entry: Always far too close to the camera. Always panicking about it.

d032.name: Despearate
d032.entry: Its head is shaped like a pear. Its outlook is shaped like a Monday.

d033.name: Cringeboi
d033.entry: Heard what you said. Tilted its head. Is choosing not to respond.

d034.name: Snorelab
d034.entry: Took part in a sleep study. The study is still recovering.

d035.name: Zapnap
d035.entry: Covered in electrodes. Worried the machine will learn it only dreams of ribs.

d036.name: Wirewilt
d036.entry: Wired up for science at 6 a.m. Fully wilted by 6:01.

d037.name: Ughsworth
d037.entry: Says 'ugh' forty times a day, mostly about traffic.

d038.name: Coolish
d038.entry: Wears the leather jacket to look cool. The nervous smile gives it away.

d039.name: Swaddlebun
d039.entry: Claims this is its baby photo. The mustache suggests otherwise.

d040.name: Broodle
d040.entry: Broods in dark sweaters. Owns forty of them, each slightly sadder.

d041.name: Lipzilla
d041.entry: Its lips arrive two full seconds before the rest of it.

d042.name: Buffering
d042.entry: Earbuds in. Nobody home. Please wait.

d043.name: Fretzel
d043.entry: Twisted into a knot of worry about whether the lounge has a free table.

d044.name: Gawkward
d044.entry: Has been gawking with its mouth open since the bill arrived.

d045.name: Wrapsody
d045.entry: Rolls itself into a blanket at 9 p.m. and declines all further plans.

d046.name: Browzer
d046.entry: Freezes solid when startled. Its eyebrows have not come down since Tuesday.

d047.name: Cheesin
d047.entry: Grins so hard in every photo that its eyes clock out for the day.

d048.name: Wheezer
d048.entry: Laughs at its own jokes before finishing them. Has never finished one.

d049.name: Suhaibro
d049.entry: Arrives every Friday. Claims the drive was 'nothing'.

d050.name: Coalsworth
d050.entry: At Haze Lounge since the coals were fresh. The coals are no longer fresh.

d051.name: Baabeque
d051.entry: Forgot the name of the ribs place. Will not admit it. Bleats sheepishly when asked.

d052.name: Manicotti
d052.entry: Grins like it has a plan. The plan is ribs. It is always ribs.

d053.name: Doubtfire
d053.entry: Has not believed a single 'five minutes away' since 2021.

d054.name: Lurkling
d054.entry: Lurks in dim lighting, side-eyeing whoever took the last dumpling.

d055.name: Unamused
d055.entry: Rated your kickflip a four. Out of a hundred.

d056.name: Sweatbeard
d056.entry: Took a steep hill on the electric skateboard once. Still recovering emotionally.

d057.name: Owlbeard
d057.entry: Its eyes go full saucer whenever the lounge runs out of mint.

d058.name: Steamboi
d058.entry: Post-ribs. Deeply satisfied. Will be asleep in ninety seconds.

d059.name: Hosehead
d059.entry: Has not let go of the shisha hose since 2022. Seems at peace with this.

d060.name: Jetlaggo
d060.entry: Just finished the long drive home. Unsure which city, day, or shirt it is in.

d061.name: Chillbao
d061.entry: Its squish-to-face ratio is the highest ever recorded. It is fine with this.

d062.name: Swabby
d062.entry: Tested negative. Wants you to know. Is showing everyone.

d063.name: Yearnling
d063.entry: Stares wistfully at your plate. Will ask if you are 'going to finish that'.

d064.name: Unbothered
d064.entry: Always films itself from below. Unbothered by the results.

d065.name: Knitpick
d065.entry: Worries about parking. And the weather. And whether you locked the car. You did.

d066.name: Armageddon
d066.entry: Throws an arm over its head at the first sign of a Monday.

d067.name: Grudgeling
d067.entry: Remembers exactly who ate its fries in 2017. Has not forgiven them.

d068.name: Pleadoh
d068.entry: Pleads for 'five more minutes' at the lounge. Has said so for three hours.

d069.name: Confuzzled
d069.entry: Has no idea what is going on. Nods along anyway. Has done so for years.

d070.name: Retesto
d070.entry: Tested again, just to be sure. And again. Holds the test closer every time.

d071.name: Kickflippo
d071.entry: Lands flawless kickflips in VR. Has not tried one in real life. 'The weather.'

d072.name: Sweatpea
d072.entry: Ordered the extra-hot wings. Is fine. Is sweating. Is fine.

d073.name: Frontcam
d073.entry: Opened the front camera by accident. Has been stuck there ever since.

d074.name: Motionblur
d074.entry: Moves too fast for any camera. Has only ever been photographed looking smug.
